item.title: Did Claude Opus 4.7 Secretly Raise Prices? 497 Developers Reveal the Truth
item.description: 497 anonymous developer submissions reveal Claude Opus 4.7 consumes 37.3% more tokens than 4.6 on average, with API costs rising proportionally. Here's what caused the 'hidden price hike' and what you can do about it.
